svg.title: Bidirectional vision attention versus causal decoder attention in a VLM
svg.desc: Inside the ViT encoder, image patches attend to every other patch in both directions. Once merged into the language decoder, attention becomes causal: a text token can attend backward to all image tokens and earlier text, but never to tokens that come after it.
svg.text: every patch sees every patch, both ways
query "the" attends back to all image + earlier text
